content.text:
current-user:
data-current-user-id=""
--- admin with session ---
302 -> http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in

observation.command: cd /tmp && rm -f cj.txt && TOKEN=$(curl -s -c cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in | grep -o 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//'); curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$TOKEN" --data-urlencode "user[email]=admin@consul.dev" --data-urlencode "user[password]=Aa12345678" -o /tmp/login.html; echo "current-user:"; grep -o 'data-current-user-id="[^"]*"' /tmp/login.html | head; grep -o 'data-current-user-id="[^"]*"' <(curl -s -b cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/) | head; echo "--- admin with session ---"; curl -s -b cj.txt -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3000/admin
